turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm feeling a bit groggy, but okay. My tummy is sore, but I expected that.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's understandable. Can you tell me your pain level on a scale from 1 to 10?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe around 4 or 5. It's manageable, but I can feel it when I move.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Alright, we'll make sure to manage your pain. Are you feeling any nausea or dizziness?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A little bit nauseous, but not too bad. I haven't eaten anything yet, though.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Okay, we'll keep an eye on that. How's your breathing? Any discomfort or shortness of breath?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Breathing is fine. I'm a bit stuffy from the tube, but I can breathe okay.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Do you remember anything from the surgery or when you were waking up?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Not really. I remember going to sleep and then waking up here. No strange dreams or anything.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Perfect. Since you have a higher BMI and diabetes, we'll monitor you closely for any complications, but so far everything looks good.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Thanks, doctor. I appreciate it. I'm just ready to go home and rest.
